aiohttp: aiohttp: the package a session is built from
request: aiohttp: the session method that takes the method as its first argument
method: aiohttp: the keyword that request method takes the method under
url: aiohttp: the keyword every session request method takes the URL under
ClientSession: aiohttp: the constructor for a session, which every request goes through
clientCall: suss: PyClientCall variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
